visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a black satin-like long-sleeved cropped top and black leather-textured shorts with high-heeled sandals, stands in a bright, modern clothing retail store. She is positioned in front of a large arched mirror, which reflects her and the store interior. She begins by pointing both hands towards the mirror with a confident facial expression. (2) The woman transitions into a rhythmic dance routine, swaying her hips and gesturing with her hands. She places her hands on her waist and then extends them outward. The background reveals racks of white and cream-colored clothing, a white spiral staircase, and a fitting room entrance with a black curtain. (3) As the dance continues, she performs a series of fluid arm movements, including touching her chest and hair, while maintaining eye contact with her reflection in the mirror. The camera remains static at eye-level, capturing her full body as she moves dynamically in the center of the frame. (4) In the final phase, she turns her body slightly, showcasing her silhouette, and ends the sequence by forming a heart shape with her hands in front of her chest, smiling warmly towards the mirror. The lighting is bright and even throughout, emphasizing the textures of her clothing and the clean aesthetic of the store.
